newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade not established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. There were 20,300 head confirmed for the week to date.
The last established price was $64.00 per cwt on Friday.
Monday's packer bids were $63.00, with asking prices $65.00-$66.00.
Note - all cattle price based on hot weights FOB the feedlot after a four percent shrink.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: None Year Ago: None
Wk to date: 20,300 Week Ago: 33,700 Year Ago: 800.
